facts.fact_text: The applicant is the pastor of the "Christ's Grace" Church of Evangelical Christians (Церковь евангельских христиан "Благодать Христова").
On 9 September 2002, the applicant applied to the Chekhov Town Council for permission to hold a service in public.
The applicant requested permission to hold the public service between 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. on 22 or 29 September 2002.

On 4 November 2002, the Moscow Regional Court upheld the judgment of the Chekhov Town Court of the Moscow Region of 11 October 2002.
